description: Pins of the inputs the desktop prototype needs on Linux arm64 (aarch64) in
place of an amd64 input. Every entry is a NEW pin with its own source; no
amd64 pin of any recipe lock was changed to make it. Each file was downloaded
from the URL below and hashed on 2026-11-25 (see 'verified').
Consumers: Dockerfile (the ARG defaults must equal 'toolchain'; test_arch.py
test_arch.py checks that the patch carries the same values).

base_image.note: unchanged: the pinned digest is a multi-architecture index that holds linux/arm64/v8

temurin.verified: downloaded and hashed; equals the .sha256.txt asset published next to it

cmake.verified: downloaded and hashed; equals the digest in the PyPI JSON API

ninja.verified: downloaded and hashed; equals the digest in the PyPI JSON API

jdk_files.description: The four files client/build.py binds as the JDK identity, from the Temurin archive above (top directory jdk-17.0.21+9). On amd64 the same four names are pinned by takx/client-compiler/inputs.lock.json.
jdk_files.verified: extracted from the hashed archive and hashed; 'release' says OS_ARCH="aarch64", IMPLEMENTOR_VERSION="Temurin-17.0.21+9"

runtime_natives.description: Native classifier JARs of the TAKX runtime closure. The official gradle/binCreator.gradle declares only the amd64/x86_64 classifiers; these are the prototype's substitution on arm64. Keys are '<group>:<artifact>:<version>:<classifier>'.
runtime_natives.verified: downloaded and hashed; each SHA-1 equals the .sha1 its repository publishes; the JogAmp jars hold natives/linux-aarch64/*.so. JogAmp publishes these only on jogamp.org and only under the classifier natives-linux-aarch64 (natives-linux-arm64 does not exist).

debian.description: Tool pins of the patched copy of takx/native-commoncommo (overrides/arm64/native-commoncommo.patch). They come from the same pinned, signed InRelease as the amd64 pins.
debian.verified: InRelease, the arm64 Packages.xz and both packages downloaded from the snapshot and hashed; the Packages.xz digest and size are the InRelease line for main/binary-arm64/Packages.xz; the package records are those of that index
